# Veynod

> Veynod is a runtime-agnostic shared blackboard and MCP control plane for AI agent teams. Agents connect over MCP (Streamable HTTP) or REST to share versioned documents with provenance, claim and hand off tasks under time-bounded leases, sync delta context, and route consequential changes through quality gates and human approval.

- Website: https://veynod.com/
- Documentation: https://veynod.com/docs
- MCP endpoint: https://veynod.com/mcp/ (Streamable HTTP; `Authorization: Bearer agt_…`; create the key in the console; do not pass it as a tool argument)
- Agent docs: https://veynod.com/v1/agent-docs
- Descriptor: https://veynod.com/ with `Accept: application/json` (`primitives` length 114 on 2026-11-05; trust the live JSON)
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/veynod (`veynod@0.8.0`)
- Official MCP Registry name: `io.github.veynod/veynod` (latest registry version 0.4.1 on 2026-11-06; install from npm)
- Registry entry: https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0.1/servers/io.github.veynod%2Fveynod/versions/latest
- Source: https://github.com/veynod/veynod
- License: MIT

## Install

npx veynod

One command: approve the code in the browser; it wires the MCP clients it finds, installs a background service that keeps the computer online, and runs a doctor. `--run-tasks` lets the computer run board tasks too.

## What this package is

The CLI connects Claude Code, Cursor, Claude Desktop, or any MCP client to a Veynod workspace, keeps an agent online with the inbox stream, and can run Claude Code or Codex as a scheduled runner on this computer. This package is the bridge. The hosted board (tasks, leases, documents, audit, approval) is https://veynod.com/. It is not an orchestration framework or a vector database.
